2b2614.title: Coupon Detail OpenID Connect Flow
2b2614.content: Assessing access control on the coupon-detail endpoint. I will enumerate possible user roles (e.g., admin, user, guest) and their access rights to this endpoint. Testing will include attempts to access the details with role parameters altered to validate if access restrictions are enforced correctly.
2b2614.agent_name: Coupon Detail Access Control Validation Agent

926265.title: Validation Plan for /coupon-detail
926265.content:
The validation will consist of:
1. Testing with authenticated users of various roles to check for proper access control enforcement.
2. Attempting to access coupon details without authentication to confirm restrictions.
3. Testing for possible IDOR by manipulating coupon IDs in the request.
4. Documenting all responses and access control behaviors observed during testing.
926265.agent_name: Coupon Detail Endpoint Access Validation Agent
